decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=<pair 7:1><pair 3:1>, kind=RESULT, payload=VALUE u32=1234 } - the reply as a relaying hop forwards it: dst shrunk by the consumed mount run, src grown at its FRONT by the PAIR of the connection vertex the reply arrived on (7:1), ahead of the terminus's seed (3:1) (RFC-0029 6.2). The src is a complete PAIR chain back to the responder.
decoded.note: PAIR arm. The hop's element is its own; the elements behind it are relayed as they arrived.
